name: test-grader
description: A side pane that grades every test in the project (strong, shallow, brittle, hollow, duplicate), tells Claude how to write tests that grade strong, and shows coverage.

graderModel.title: Grader model
graderModel.description: The model that grades tests: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a model id. haiku by default, which Claude Code resolves to the Haiku it is set up with. A model id is used exactly as set, so a gateway's own ids work.

graderEscalate.title: Second-look model
graderEscalate.description: A model that grades again what the first grade flagged: regrades after an edit, evidence and verified mutations. off: the grader model does it all.

graderWorkers.title: Grader workers
graderWorkers.description: How many grader calls run at once during Grade all tests, from 1 to 20.

measureStrong.title: Measure strong grades
measureStrong.description: While the session is idle, try the bug each strong grade names on a few tests at a time, and grade shallow any test that still passes. Go is built with the change through -overlay, its files untouched.

measureInPlace.title: Measure by changing files
measureInPlace.description: Measure strong grades in languages other than Go too, by changing the code under test for the run and putting it back. Off by default: another session or worker in the same folder would see the change while it runs.
